programDescription: In this program, you learn how to visualize and analyze data using R and Python coding software to then build machine learning models and understand data ethics. This provides a pathway for many hands-on careers in the field of computer science and statistics.
admissionCoursesNeeded: Grade 12, English ENG4U, Advanced Function MHF4U (Minimum 67%). Biology SBI4U, Chemistry SCH4U, Physics SPH4U. Grade 11 Chemistry SCH3U.
academicCostDetails: Student fees, such as accessibility for the athletic recreation center and student union services. And other fees for library and media funds. Textbooks
livingCostDetails: There are fees for living and the meal plan. UBC offers a U-Pass BC program, which is a program that runs and gives students accessible public transportation around the city of Kelowna.
interestingFacts: When staying on the Okanagan campus, there are 2000 annual hours of sunshine with an average temperature of 25 Celsius from May to August and -4.7 Celsius from December to March. They have a 1560 square meter gymnasium, which is the size of 3.5 NBA courts. UBC has a Quadball Team, which is a sport based on the Harry Potter game Quidditch, and has played in games in North America, representing Vancouver or Canada itself.
